verdict.rationale: Expensify's own marketing claims it can 'automatically ... approve' expenses (expensify-docs-27), 'automate compliance' (expensify-docs-32), 'build rules' when configuring workspaces (expensify-docs-4), and apply 'your policies' (expensify-docs-30). These are glancing one-line claims with no documentation of how a policy is actually codified or how exceptions are routed to a human. Missing for 10: documented per-category/role/context expense limits, explicit auto-approve-if-in-policy rules, exception-only routing to human approvers, in-depth help docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
